scientific_semantics.freeze_rule: ALL event definitions, feature universe, P01-P08 architectures and grids, validation selection, horizons, support rules, controllers/economics, bootstrap/PBO, gates, seeds and classification enum are byte-level inherited from the immutable 0067 preregistration; 0069 may not reinterpret or tune them.

execution_assurance.economic_fit_calls_rule: manifest-derived from realized eligibility under frozen 0067 rules; never hard-code 11904 unless realized regime is FULL_SUPPORT
execution_assurance.p08_nnls_rule: manifest-derived from realized P08 eligibility under frozen 0067 rules; never hard-code 40 unless realized regime is FULL_SUPPORT
execution_assurance.manifest_rule: single canonical ordered manifest, deterministic canonical JSON, SHA256-bound; qualification, preflight dry run and historical execution use the same graph-builder entry point
execution_assurance.terminal_trace_rule: every manifest unit receives exactly one terminal trace before inference
execution_assurance.physical_accounting_rule: sum(expected_fit_calls)==observed estimator fit attempts and sum(expected_nnls)==observed NNLS solves; any mismatch is INVALID_EXECUTION
execution_assurance.inference_barrier: predictive/economic inference is forbidden until complete manifest consumption and physical-accounting equality

time_and_economic_contract.decision_timing: prediction after completed close t may affect only portfolio return row t+1

exactly_once.marker_only_recovery: only if complete PRIMARY_RESULT+EVIDENCE+EXECUTION already durably persist and only RUN_ONCE.marker is missing
